set.st: Fred Peters, plowing the pasture of the old Jones-Gorlick farm on the north shore of Briggs Lake on 7 Jul 1922, overturned a stump and unearthed gold and silver coins dated 1847-1862 with remnants of a sack and a wad of rotted bills. The first wire (Clear Lake, 11 Jul 1922) put the money at nearly $3,000; the fuller account has over $18 gathered, so the total is uncertain. Probably a Civil War specie hoard. Pin is approximate, not the spot itself.
src: Clipping relayed in Colville (Wash.) Examiner 29 Jul 1922 from a Minnesota paper (TN TreasureNet Treasure Legends - Minnesota thread 556519). Two period prints now, though both may stem from one wire. Princeton Union 1922 and LoC MN papers searched: no account there. Sherburne Co. Star News (Elk River) Jul 1922 would be the local source
